en: Sepia-toned winter scene showing a small brick church with a tiled gable roof and a modest wooden bell tower topped by a cross. Bare trees surround the building, and snow covers the ground. A lone figure wearing a long dark coat and light head covering walks along a path next to a simple wire or rope fence. Some construction materials or wooden benches lie near the church walls. The image has the proportions and border style typical of early 20th‑century photographic postcards. In the lower right corner there is faint mirrored text, likely part of a publisher's imprint.
